items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Interviewee discusses Buddy Johnson's band style ('big time', 'society band') and confirms he had a band, but explicitly states 'Yank played with me' while only saying 'Yeah, he had a band' regarding Buddy Johnson, indicating no direct personal collaboration or meeting is confirmed in the text.

ctx.x: And in the old days, Frankie Doosen had sort of a rough, you know, ratty band.
That played for the barrel house style. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Buddy Johnson had a, what you call it, what you call it, a big time, you know.
How long was Buddy Johnson around? Was he still playing when you started across the river? Sure he was playing. He was still there then.
